status: Analytical expectations and planning examples; no measured SupaBiz improvement

bounds.without: O(N) scan per query; O(N²) all-pairs matching
bounds.with_approach: O(log N + k) indexed lookup, with bounded candidate k
bounds.caveat: Ambiguous/fuzzy joins can approach quadratic; cap candidates and escalate rather than silently miss.

bounds.without: O(NR) full evaluation for N records and R applicable rules
bounds.with_approach: O(VR) for affected dependency closure V
bounds.caveat: V may equal N for global rules; retain full recompute reference and version invalidation.

bounds.without: M messages each trigger a model loop
bounds.with_approach: qM eligible triggers, plus bounded follow-up calls
bounds.space: Durable capture remains O(M) metadata plus media
bounds.caveat: q is measured; routing must be evaluated for missed work. Fewer calls are not automatically fewer errors.

bounds.without: Unbounded download/decoding and full history in context
bounds.with_approach: O(B) byte processing with per-job/concurrency caps; scoped evidence retrieval
bounds.space: O(B) retained evidence, bounded active working set
bounds.caveat: Sampling video reduces processed frames but loses coverage; no unobserved-event absence claims.

bounds.without: Long model calls hold record locks
bounds.with_approach: Snapshot/version → slow work outside transaction → short guarded commit
bounds.caveat: Hot records still serialize; measure conflicts and queue delay. Do not promise linear scaling.

cost_formula: Monthly total = allocated infrastructure + connector operations + media + model tokens/tool calls + storage/backups/egress + human review + support/recovery. Divide by correct completed workflows; also report cost per attempted workflow.

illustrative_inputs.currency: USD; arbitrary sensitivity inputs, not quotes

measurement: p50/p95 source-to-visible and source-to-completed latency; break out wait/review/model/queue time
Correct completion among all eligible cases; abstention and unresolved coverage alongside conditional extraction accuracy
False acceptance, wrong-tenant/matter disclosure, duplicate effects and unsupported certainty by risk slice
Human correction/review minutes; staff interruptions and repeated questions
Actual invoices/usage and all-in workflow cost, not model price alone
pilot_targets: Provisional, to freeze with pilot owner in S0: zero critical forbidden effects in the enumerated release suite; 100 representative shadow cases per released workflow before expanding autonomy; paired reviewer-effort/cost comparison with no quality regression. These sample targets do not establish rare-event safety.
scaling_triggers: Start with one control-plane deployment and separate worker pools; per-tenant quotas from day one.
Scale workers when queue delay breaches the agreed p95 target; preserve provider-rate and review-capacity limits.
Partition busy objects/tenants only after measured contention; avoid global serialization and avoid invented actor counts.
Add retrieval indexing when measured search latency/quality requires it; ACL filtering precedes disclosure.
Add dedicated tenant deployments only for contractual isolation/residency or measured noisy-neighbor requirements.
